narrative.overview: The page is a dark room until you light it. The ground starts at near-black blue, a flashlight follows the pointer over the hero photo, and a physical switch plate and a header dimmer raise the whole page toward a warm bright gallery. Light is the one state variable: a single motion value (0 to 1) drives the page background, the photo brightness, the hero darkness mask and the ink flip. Everything else is quiet so the finished rooms carry the proof.
keyCharacteristics: One light level (0 to 1) governs ground color, photo brightness, hero mask radius and ink flip.
Dark by default, bright when lit; both states are fully designed, not inverted by filter.
Heavy, tight display type over a regular grotesque body at 19px.
Photo-first sections with 18 to 26px rounded frames; flat except for hardware objects.
Pill-shaped controls, one blue action color.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Background, photo brightness and ink are functions of the single light value, never separate toggles. Ground stops: 0 night, 0.5 dusk, 0.85 dawn, 1 day. Photo brightness is 0.5 + 0.5 * light^0.8. Ink flips at 0.68.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Switch Blue is the only saturated color on the page. Warm tungsten is light, never a button.

rules.name: The Two Ink Rule
rules.body: Text is either cream on dark or graphite on light; secondary text uses the matching mute value. Never leave cream text on a day ground.

rules.name: The Heavy Tight Rule
rules.body: Every heading is Bricolage 800 (700 for row titles) with -0.03em tracking and balanced wrapping.

rules.name: The Controls Only Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels belong to controls and form fields, not to introduce sections.

rules.name: The Hardware Only Rule
rules.body: Shadow belongs to things you can press (switch, rocker, thumb) and to the hero panel; text, sections and the estimate form carry none.

dos: Do derive ground, photo brightness and ink from the one light value; keep the 0.68 ink flip.
Do use Switch Blue only for the primary action and its state (toggle pill, submit).
Do set headings in Bricolage Grotesque 800 at -0.03em and body in Schibsted Grotesk.
Do keep controls pill-shaped and at least 44px tall, primary actions 56px.
Do keep photos in rounded frames with real alt text; place new hardware-like objects on the plate gradient with soft shadow.
Do show both lit and unlit states of any new component.
donts: Don't put cream text on the day ground or graphite text on the night ground; use the matching ink pair.
Don't use a second saturated color for actions; tungsten is only light, focus and track fill.
Don't apply shadows to sections, headings or the estimate form.
Don't use hard offset shadows, glyph icons or uppercase intros above headings.
Don't use filter inversion to fake the day state; define the day values.
